name: Sideshow
label: 10K
lede: Sideshow, born in Tigray and raised in the DMV, spent six years putting out short, murky tapes from LA. Then came 32 tracks across four discs and an 8.4 from Pitchfork.

eras.title: A year of tapes, and a war back home
eras.text: Three projects land in 2020, all listed on 10K, built from underground beatmakers and guests out of the same drumless, jazz-flecked rap scene as MIKE, MAVI and Earl Sweatshirt. In November, war breaks out in Tigray, where he was born.

years.h: Farley brings MIKE, MAVI and ZelooperZ to a first mixtape
years.p: Na-Kel Smith and Medhane are on it too, and [[Alexander Spit|e100d317-f6e9-4f2b-9002-e13087e02f87]] is one of the producers.
years.xp:
Album of the Year lists Farley as a February 24, 2020 mixtape with production from Budgie, Kahlil Blu, Sid Roams, supersportlo and Alexander Spit, among others.

Wikipedia's Alexander Spit page dates the tape to 2013, which does not match any other source; the page uses 2020.

years.h: Five weeks later, Asked Amlak to Wash My Hands
years.p: Spit and CoffeeBlack produce. The Ginger Shot EP is also dated 2020.

years.src: Wikipedia: Tigray war · BLAC D.C.: Artist of the Week Sideshow
years.h: Tigray goes to war, and Sideshow says so in public
years.p: Ethiopian federal forces, allied with Eritrea, fight the TPLF. A 2022 BLAC D.C. profile calls him a vocal advocate for Tigrayans on social media.
years.xp:
Wikipedia dates the war from November 3, 2020 to a cessation of hostilities agreement signed November 2, 2022.

BLAC D.C. also describes a multi-hyphenate: rapper, model, graphic and fashion designer, with campaigns for Carhartt, Converse and Snobs Downtown, and a clothing line called Unknown Assailant.

eras.title: Deadpan in a drumless room
eras.text: Two releases, one leap. Wicked Man's Reprise brings the guests and the Spit beats; WEGAHTA TAPES VOL. 1 brings Pitchfork.

years.src: AOTY: Wicked Man's Reprise · Fresh Music Freaks: Sideshow Unveils New Album
yt: Live at Songbyrd, Washington DC, October 14, 2021
years.h: Jazzy loops and a MAVI verse on Wicked Man's Reprise
years.p: Spit produces several tracks, joined by Black Noi$e, Bori and CoffeeBlack. Na-Kel Smith is also a guest.
years.xp:
Fresh Music Freaks lists [[Navy Blue|304c731f-ea4f-407c-b4fc-65131b1b2b37]] among the guests, alongside MAVI and Na-Kel Smith.

Album of the Year users file it under drumless, jazz-rap and East Coast hip-hop. Fan-shot video from Songbyrd in Washington, October 14, 2021, shows the live set from the same year.

q: a vivid panorama of his existence with each deadpan bar
years.src: AOTY: WEGAHTA TAPES VOL. 1 · BLAC D.C.: Artist of the Week Sideshow
years.h: WEGAHTA TAPES VOL. 1 runs ten tracks and sixteen minutes
years.p: MIKE and MAVI feature. Pitchfork's Dylan Green hears a rapper burrowing deeper into a subdued sound.
years.xp:
Album of the Year dates the mixtape to May 13, 2022; BLAC D.C.'s June 6 profile describes it as out that week, so the exact day is loose.

The same profile says he had toured the previous year on Small World Big Love with MIKE and Osun, with sold-out shows from Richmond to New York, and that he splits his time between LA and the DC area.

eras.title: Faster, meaner, more of it
eras.text: An LP, an EP and an album in sixteen months, grimier than before, with Spit still around and El Cousteau turning up as a co-writer.

years.cap: Sideshow with arms raised in front of a horse mural, 2024
years.h: Valee drops in on the title track of 2MM DON'T JUST STAND THERE!
years.p: Producers include Spit, Popstar Benny, AYOCHILLMANNN and Omari Lyseight. HipHopDX's Mackenzie Cummings-Grady scored it 82.
years.xp: Cummings-Grady wrote that the cloudy loops had become more claustrophobic, but that Sideshow sometimes used the dense backdrops to sneak in some optimism.

years.h: JAM is a twelve-minute EP of Alexander Spit beats
years.p: Seven tracks, a joint release with the LA producer; El Cousteau appears on one.

years.cap: Sideshow crouching in front of a horse-mural shutter in Japan, 2024
years.src: AOTY: F.U.N. T.O.Y. · Hip-Hop Wired: Sideshow Defiantly Highlights
years.h: T-Pain and Still UA both land on F.U.N. T.O.Y.
years.p: Seventeen tracks. Pitchfork's Dash Lewis scored it 7.6 and credited the crackling production for its energy.
years.xp:
Bandcamp credits JWLES, T-Pain, MAY DAY, El Cousteau and Still UA as features. Producers include Popstar Benny, Rorzhak, Alexander Spit, EazyT. and Blase. Hip-Hop Wired later named it among its best projects of 2024.

Lewis's line: grimier and druggier than ever. The same critic would review TIGRAY FUNK two years later.

eras.title: The big one, 32 tracks long
eras.text: Two years of recording end in the biggest release of his career. Before it lands he is on stage across Europe with Earl Sweatshirt; after it, Pitchfork tags it Best New Music.

years.src: V13: Sideshow Announces February 27th Release · The FADER: Sideshow announces new album TIGRAY FUNK · Hip-Hop Wired: Sideshow Defiantly Highlights
years.h: Earl Sweatshirt takes Sideshow across Europe
years.p: The European leg of the 3L World Tour ran January 20 to February 6, five weeks before the album.
years.xp: V13 and The FADER both note the run; The FADER says the album came out of two years of recording. Earl Sweatshirt, as randomblackdude, is credited with producing on the album per Hip-Hop Wired.

years.src: The FADER: Sideshow announces new album TIGRAY FUNK · BrooklynVegan: Sideshow announces new album
yt: LIFES AS VIOLENT AS YOU MAKE IT
years.h: "LIFES AS VIOLENT AS YOU MAKE IT" sets up the album
years.p: Spit produces and Juan Nieto directs the video. The album is announced the same day for February 27 on 10K.

years.cap: Sideshow in close-up around the release of TIGRAY FUNK, 2026
years.src: Good Stuff Only: Sideshow's constant chaos · The FADER: Sideshow announces new album TIGRAY FUNK · In Search of Media: sideshow tigray funk · BrooklynVegan: Sideshow announces new album · Hip-Hop Wired: Sideshow Defiantly Highlights
years.h: TIGRAY FUNK fills four discs with 32 tracks
years.p: Producers include Tony Seltzer, Laron, Anysia Kym, Popstar Benny and Surf Gang's harrison; guests are [[Niontay|f82718b9-abf9-4dc1-8c0e-eea218c2b973]], El Cousteau, Kelow Latesha and SEXWORKS.
years.xp:
Good Stuff Only calls it possibly the first four-disc rap album. The FADER says it grapples with the Tigray War's personal cost and with being a Black man in America, and Brooklyn Vegan notes a parable running through it.

In Search of Media's reviewer points to the ethio-jazz feel of "ALENA (ኣለና) PARADISE LOST." Hip-Hop Wired notes that he rarely does press.

years.big: a dazed survey of personal highs and lows
years.src: AOTY: TIGRAY FUNK · Kurrco on X
years.h: Pitchfork scores TIGRAY FUNK 8.4 and tags it Best New Music
years.p: Pitchfork's Dash Lewis: the Tigray-born, DMV-raised rapper's flow rides roughshod over his producers' strangest beats.
years.xp: The score and the tag show up in AOTY's critic table and in a Kurrco post dated March 4, 2026. AOTY users rated it 76 out of 100.

years.src: The FADER: Sideshow disses JPEGMAFIA · Wikipedia: Pompeii // Utility
years.h: Sideshow answers JPEGMAFIA with "EXPERIMENTAL RAP (BLACK CROSS+)"
years.p: Dylvinci produces the reply to JPEGMAFIA's remarks about Earl Sweatshirt and MIKE's Pompeii // Utility.
years.xp: The FADER reports that JPEGMAFIA called the Earl and MIKE double album not experimental enough and that Earl answered with memes on Instagram. Pompeii // Utility, made entirely with Surf Gang production, is dated April 3, 2026.

yt: Full set, Pearl Street Warehouse, June 4, 2026
years.h: Pearl Street Warehouse sells out in Washington, DC
years.p: El Rocco and Falamoun open; Union Stage's listing bills him as a rapper from Addis Ababa raised in the DMV.
years.xp: The full 54-minute set from the night is on video.
